sources.note: equipment plan source (research grade: datasheet); size 215 x 197.5 x 381.5 mm (w x d x h); port and control positions are placeholders until measured

NS-10M STUDIO owner manual specifications page (a manualsdir copy) read 2026-11-12: "381.5 mm x 215 mm x 197.5 mm", 6.3 kg (one speaker), 10.4 litre sealed enclosure, LF 18 cm cone and HF 3.5 cm soft dome. The page labels the order W x H x D, which would make the box wider than tall, so the plan assigned h 381.5, w 215 (axis order inferred: estimate, hence beta-modelled only). A manual page (search summary) says the speaker has "large screw-type terminals": modelled as one pair of binding posts (`binding-post`, the closest catalogue connector; the count of terminal pairs is one per speaker); the connector type is therefore not documented. The corner radius is our estimate. The position is a guess. Generic artwork only: a white-cone woofer and a dome drawn as plain circles, no photo, no logo.
